definitions.explanation: Official permission or sanction from authorities to do something.
Official recognition that something meets required standards.

examples.japanese: {新薬|しんやく}が{認可|にんか}された。
{認可|にんか}{保育園|ほいくえん}に{入|はい}れた。
examples.english: I got into a licensed daycare.

examples.japanese: {認可|にんか}を{申請|しんせい}する。

notes:
COLLOCATIONS:
- {認可|にんか}を{受|う}ける: to receive authorization
- {認可|にんか}を{申請|しんせい}する: to apply for approval
- {認可|にんか}{保育園|ほいくえん}: licensed daycare
- {無認可|むにんか}: unlicensed, unauthorized

CONTRAST:
- {承認|しょうにん}: approval (more general)
- {許可|きょか}: permission (for specific actions)
